agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 12, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Deacon Loi Hoang, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
No presentations are scheduled on this agenda. *3
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending November 30, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Local Taxpayer, Public Safety and Transportation Protection Act of 2010 (CC)
C5.
Application for General Mills "Champion for Healthy Kids" Grant (CC)
C6.
Lobelia Drive at Sycamore Avenue Bus Zone and No Stopping Zone (CC)
C7.
N. Santa Fe Avenue Traffic Signal Interconnect Project Change Order (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving Change Order No. 2, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the documents; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2009/2010.
C8.
All-Way Stop on W. Los Angeles Drive at W. California Avenue (CC)
C9.
W. California Avenue Street Improvement Project (CIP No. 8029) Purchase of 14 Easements and Award Construction Agreement (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving fourteen acquisition agreements for the purchase of public street and utility easements as required for the project;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , awarding a contract to Sierra Pacific West, Inc., for construction of the project; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a construction agreement with Vista Irrigation District for water improvements.
C10.
Fire Department Strategic Plan (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fire Department Standards of Response Coverage (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Recreation & Community Services Facility Rental and Program Fees (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the facility and rental fees.
PH2.
Land Acquisition and Building Lease for 325-327 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing.
2.
Adopt the following resolutions for the property at 325-327 S. Santa Fe Avenue:
a.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , approving a Purchase and Sales Agreement, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the transaction; and
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , authorizing the Chairperson to execute a Lease Agreement with the Richard and Helen Tjaden 2006 Trust.
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2009/2010.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
